hypothesis.method: Neuroevolution of Augmenting Topologies (NEAT) with brain-inspired synaptic plasticity rules applied to self-organizing map (SOM) structures for unsupervised learning of latent semantic spaces in real-time sensor streams.
hypothesis.problem: Current unsupervised learning systems fail to adapt dynamically to non-stationary, high-dimensional sensory inputs without labeled data, leading to poor generalization and concept drift.
hypothesis.goal: Achieve continuous, autonomous refinement of latent feature representations that maintain topological invariance while improving classification accuracy under changing environmental conditions.
